title: DriftReport
description: One project-level drift analysis report. Drift compares two or more project surfaces such as specs, tasks, jobs, ADRs, source code, README, AGENTS, marketing, design, tests, runtime behavior, process rules, report schemas, and token usage.

reportId.description: Stable id for this drift report. Prefer ULID or UUID v7.

project.description: Project name as shown in the project organization layer.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the report was created.

trigger.description: What caused the drift analysis to run.

sourceRefs.description: Documents, folders, reports, or event streams that were included.

overallScore.description: Triage score. Higher is healthier, lower means more drift risk.

scoreBand.description: Human-facing score band derived from overallScore and high-severity findings.

summary.description: Short human summary of the drift state.

score.description: Per-dimension triage score. Higher is healthier.

severity.description: Worst current finding severity for this dimension.

confidence.description: Model or analyzer confidence in the dimension assessment.

sourceCoverage.description: How much of the expected source set was actually inspected.

status.description: User or system tracking state for the dimension's current findings.

summary.description: Short explanation of the drift finding.

evidenceRefs.description: Paths or ids for evidence used by this dimension.

architectureModel.description: Optional high-level architecture model used for software-to-architecture drift. Intended for a marble-style project view. Keep the model small enough for humans to scan. The authoring contract for the source model (Markdown + frontmatter, stored with project evidence) lives in docs/architecture-model.md and is validated by docs/schemas/architecture-model.schema.json. The block here is the per-report projection: it carries scoring fields keyed by the source model's elementId.

modelId.description: Stable id for the architecture model used by this report.

sourceRef.description: Path or id of the source architecture document that defined this model.

elements.description: High-level architecture elements. Hard limit of ten keeps the map reviewable.

elementId.description: Stable id for the architecture element.

label.description: Short display label for the marble.

expectedRole.description: What this element is supposed to own or do.

guidelines.description: Important rules this element should follow.

allowedDependencies.description: Element ids or external systems this element may depend on.

sourceRefs.description: Docs, folders, schemas, tests, runtime streams, or reports used to assess this element.

score.description: Per-element drift score. Higher is healthier.

severity.description: Worst current finding severity for this element.

sourceCoverage.description: How much of the expected source set for this element was inspected.

status.description: Tracking state for this element's current drift.

summary.description: Short explanation of this element's drift state.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence paths or ids that explain this element's score.

followUpTaskSuggestions.description: Normal queued tasks that could reduce drift.
